package worker

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"os"

	"github.com/aws/aws-sdk-go-v2/aws"
	"github.com/aws/aws-sdk-go-v2/service/s3"
	sm "github.com/aws/aws-sdk-go-v2/service/secretsmanager"
	"github.com/aws/aws-sdk-go-v2/service/sqs"
	"example.com/mono/shared/env"
)

func upload(ctx context.Context, c *s3.Client) {
	bucket := env.GetOrElse(ctx, "EXPORT_BUCKET_NAME", "")
	c.PutObject(ctx, &s3.PutObjectInput{Bucket: aws.String(bucket), Key: aws.String("k")})
}
